critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/directory.py:143-153 _CACHE is a plain module-level dict without locking; concurrent requests during index rebuild can each fire the full aggregation. Not a correctness bug (result is identical) but consider an asyncio.Lock per category to avoid a thundering-herd cost when the 45s TTL expires. Impact today: negligible (~1 request/s peak).

backend/routes/directory.py:143-149 the cache is process-local; on a multi-worker deployment each worker independently rebuilds and invalidates. If uvicorn is ever scaled up (--workers >1), a POST import will only invalidate one worker's cache and the other workers keep serving stale rows for up to 45s. Consider moving cache to a lightweight redis or triggering invalidation via a DB collection watcher.

backend/routes/guest.py:210-247 guest_login uses ISO string comparison on locked_until (`locked > now.isoformat()`); works because both sides are timezone-aware UTC strings from now_iso(), but is fragile if any future code path writes locked_until as a native datetime or with a different offset. Prefer parsing both sides to datetime and comparing objects.

backend/routes/guest.py:184-201 the lookup regex is un-escaped — if a user searches a name containing regex metacharacters (`.` `*` `(`), the query would blow up on MongoDB. Wrap needle in re.escape() before building the $regex, or use $text index.
